newsitem.title: CROATIA: BASKETBALL-TEAMSYSTEM BOLOGNA BEAT CIBONA ZAGREB TO TOP GROUP.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-TEAMSYSTEM BOLOGNA BEAT CIBONA ZAGREB TO TOP GROUP.

text.p: Italy's Teamsystem Bologna beat Cibona Zagreb 71-64 on Wednesday to consign the Croatian club to their second successive defeat in Group B of the men's basketball EuroLeague.
The Bologna club played well in defence to keep Cibona's long-range shooters out of the game and moved to the top of Group B with four wins in five matches.
Bologna, 31-30 up at halftime, had Americans Carlton Myers and Conrad McRae to thank for their victory.

Five minutes from the end the score stood locked at 56-56 but then point guard Carlton Myers hit a three-pointer, his third in the 11-point streak, and centre-forward McRae added four points for the lead Bologna never lost.
Myers and McRae finished the match with 19 points each.

A three-pointer from playmaker Damir Mulaomerovic, which brought Cibona within four points of their opponents three minutes from the end, gave the home team a glimmer of hope but a series of mistakes on the offence thwarted it.
Bologna's aggressive defence was the key to their fourth win in five games.
Mulaomerovic was held to 13 points, including three three-pointers.
Greek club Olympiakos, who shared the group lead with Cibona and Bologna before Wednesday's matches, face Estudiantes Madrid at home on Thursday.
